unsupported.accessibilityFeatures: not implemented: needs a browser-wide ChromeSetting store
unsupported.contentSettings: not implemented: terminal-browser has no per-site content settings
unsupported.desktopCapture: not supported: no desktop picker in a terminal
unsupported.fontSettings: not implemented: pages render with the terminal-browser font setup
unsupported.gcm: intentionally absent: needs Google's push service
unsupported.privacy: not implemented: needs a browser-wide ChromeSetting store
unsupported.readingList: intentionally absent: no reading list UI
unsupported.surface:page|tabs.createSplit: split views are newer than Electron 44's Chromium; terminal-browser has no split views
unsupported.surface:page|tabs.unsplit: split views are newer than Electron 44's Chromium; terminal-browser has no split views
unsupported.surface:sw|tabs.createSplit: split views are newer than Electron 44's Chromium; terminal-browser has no split views
unsupported.surface:sw|tabs.unsplit: split views are newer than Electron 44's Chromium; terminal-browser has no split views
unsupported.sw|tabs.createSplit: split views are newer than Electron 44's Chromium; terminal-browser has no split views
unsupported.sw|tabs.onDetached+onAttached: tabs can't move between terminal panes
unsupported.sw|tabs.unsplit: split views are newer than Electron 44's Chromium; terminal-browser has no split views
unsupported.sw|windows.create#tabId: tabs can't move between terminal panes
unsupported.sw|windows.update#bounds+onBoundsChanged: the terminal owns pane size and position
unsupported.sw|windows.update#state: the terminal owns pane size and state
unsupported.tabCapture: not supported: no tab capture streams
unsupported.tabGroups: stubbed: terminal-browser has no tab groups
unsupported.webAuthenticationProxy: not implemented: no remote desktop WebAuthn proxying

notRun.^instanceID\\.(getID|getCreationTime)$: needs the internet: Chrome asks Google's GCM servers for the ID, and runs are offline
